rationale: The plan matches the reference design exactly: balanced batch enters the negative-binomial model as ~ batch + condition, counts are kept raw with explicit reasoning against pre-correcting the matrix, VST is confined to visualisation, and edgeR QL on the identical design serves as a sensitivity check rather than a replacement. QC is thorough and design-specific (library sizes, PCA coloured by condition and shaped by batch with percent variance, annotated distance heatmap, variance partition, and an explicit no-silent-drop outlier policy), the filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, tied to the smallest group size) is minimal and justified, and normalization is model-internal (median-of-ratios, TMM). Contrast direction, reference level, and apeglm-by-coef are all specified, and BH at 0.05 with both padj-only and effect-size-filtered counts is reported, though the |log2FC|>1 cut is applied post hoc rather than as an lfcThreshold in the test. Enrichment is well specified (full ranked list with stated metric, seed, 10-500 size window, tested-gene ORA background, named human hallmark/GO-BP collections, redundancy collapsing) but omits collection versions; likewise the reporting section covers method, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, NA handling, and design caveats but never commits to stating software versions.
